title: Absolute floor added to the latency-degradation threshold
stage: pre-launch rehearsal (before any campaign data existed)
runs_disposition: 3 rehearsal runs reset and re-collected. Blast radius was recomputable from persisted spans (compose-post-service 1/1/0 -> 1/0/0) but T_rec was not, because recovery-probe windows are not persisted and downstream_affected was 1-3 in the majority of samples preceding the first all-clear.

title: Fault targeting resolved by compose label; stack completeness enforced
outcome_affected: all outcomes for the affected runs
runs_disposition: reservation|kill|1 (wrong container faulted), search|kill|1 and user|kill|1 (incomplete topology). All 3 reset and re-collected. All 22 Social Network runs to that point were verified clean; the collision cannot occur there because no SN service name is a substring of 'socialnetwork'.

title: Graph/Jaeger service names are not docker compose service names
stage: 28 minutes after resuming; caused a false abort, no data affected
runs_disposition: No data affected. The abort occurred before any Social Network run started; the gate refused to run rather than producing garbage, which is the designed behaviour acting on a wrong premise.

title: Leaked pumba netem rule contaminated 10 later runs
stage: detected by the pre-analysis gates immediately after run 180
outcome_affected: ancestor_affected_count (systematically under-counted), T_rec for the origin run
runs_disposition: 10 contaminated runs plus the origin run reset and re-collected. The origin run was also invalid on its own terms: recorded as censored on p95, but its fault was still active throughout its recovery probe. It was the campaign's only censored observation; the corrected dataset has none.

title: Two specification gaps resolved by the principal investigator
Zero censoring promoted Spearman to primary for T_rec
Documentation inconsistency: section 7.2's stated Hotel Reservation p-value is the asymptotic one
Primary test's raw p superseded by exact enumeration (Monte-Carlo -> exact)
stage: after the confirmatory analysis was complete and committed
outcome_affected: raw and BH-adjusted p-values only; no rho, CI, effect size, outcome or verdict changed

title: Preregistered cross-architecture weight-tuning protocol not executed; inherited weights used
stage: in code before the lock; first recorded after the lock and after the campaign data had been analysed
outcome_affected: the hybrid_criticality predictor (H1b and every comparator test using it); no outcome measurement

title: Social Network per-service latency used all of a service's spans, recorded as server spans
stage: found after the analysis was complete; sensitivity replay run post hoc
outcome_affected: Social Network ancestor/descendant/unrelated affected counts and T_rec (measurement scope); replay shows no service-level change in the affected counts
runs_disposition: No run reset or re-collected. Stored outcomes retained; the replay is a post-hoc sensitivity analysis in separate files.

title: hotelreservation|rate|latency|1 attempted twice; first attempt's spans persisted without a run record
runs_disposition: Second attempt retained. Every stack was brought down and the Hotel Reservation stack brought back up at 06:31:48 UTC between the two attempts, so the first attempt's fault cannot have carried into the second.

title: Baseline window includes the load ramp-up
stage: found during manuscript preparation, after the analysis
outcome_affected: none known; the size of any ramp-up effect on the baselines was not measured
